Eternal Line was the seventh line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Forest Village and Quin Biome, and had a total of 18 stations. It was established alongside Edward Sphere Station on August 7 2013. Moreover, a branch between Bear Trapp and Capillaris was set up on this branch, which commenced services on August 15 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Eternal Line was the seventh District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled from southeast Terracept Continent to north Terracept Continent.

This line was represented by the Pink Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 6.

At the time of its closure, this route was 27.3 km long, with a total of 18 stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is a triangular line with three termini, meaning that trains between the Capillaris Branch, the Quin Biome branch and the south terminus at Forest Village can travel to and from each other. This makes Eternal Line the only line in Nazca Railway history to have such a layout.[2]
  • This line is named after the United States of EtErNalGLX, one of the four former kingdoms of Terracept.

History[]

  • August 7 2013: Grand Ruin - Terracept
  • August 15 2013: Grand Ruin - Capillaris
  • August 20 2013: Grand Ruin - Capillaris / Quin Biome
  • December 27 2013: Sandstone Shoal - Capillaris / Quin Biome
  • January 7 2014: Forest Village - Capillaris / Quin Biome (Line Complete)

Europa Checkpoint is a checkpoint on Minecraft Line, Oasis Bay Line, Stadow Line, Charlie Line and Echo Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Jupiter. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line, Labyrinth Line (Rapid), Snow White Line (Europa Station) and SLT Line 2301 (Europa Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • While Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint was meant to be one single large checkpoint, it was split into two different checkpoints due to schanges in plans, with the second checkpoint being this station. In total, the two Checkpoints serve seven lines.
  • This Station is the first station to feature two different Los Sengas Coffees.[10]
  • This Station is home to a former Construction Team named Jupituropa, and as the name of that team alludes to Jupiter, the name of this station also alludes to Europa, one of the moons of Jupiter.[11]
  • This Station is the first Checkpoint to feature NR Shops. However, the NR Shops did not begin operations until after the extension of Stadow Line to this station.
  • The construction of this station began mid-January of 2019, but was not completed until February 2 that same year. The construction works took more than ten days.
  • The percentage of Sandstone on the Platform Walls increase with the platform depth as it is believed that shallower depths mean lower degrees of darkness.[12]
  • This Station is the first station in Los Sengas Division besides of Metropolis Terminal have two-digit platforms.
  • This Station is the first Checkpoint in Nazca Railway to NOT feature any lines from Season 1.
  • The Transfer Passageways of This Station can form a complete loop across all concourses of this station from both inside and outside the gate areas.

History[]

  • January 25 2019: This Station resumed works. At the time, all platforms and concourse structures have already completed construction.[13]
  • February 2 2019: This Station completed construction.[14]
  • February 4 2019: This Station began services alongside Minecraft Line and Charlie Line, but West Oasis Bay Line, Stadow Line and Echo Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • February 12 2019: West Oasis Bay Line is established.
  • February 21 2019: Echo Line is established.
  • December 22 2019: Oasis Bay Line merges with West Oasis Bay Line.
  • December 24 2019: Stadow Line extended from Freedom Bay Station to this station through Quad-Entryway Station, Stadow Line Phase 1 completed construction.[15]
  • June 19 2021: Exits F1, F2, G1 and G2 are added to this station.[16]
  • April 28 2022: Exits F1 and F2 have completed renaming.[17]
  • March 28 2024: Epsilon Line is renamed Echo Line.

However, subsequent development had seen the 2 platforms being replaced by three platforms that is served by an undisclosed line. While the name of the line remains unknown, it is known that the line will be operated by Nawis Railway as well.

Everbond Station is a station on Pegasus Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Oasis Bay. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2410 (Everbond NR Station Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • While there is another Nawis Railway station with the same name (Snow White Line Everbond Station), there are no connections between these two stations as this station is located at more than one kilometer to the west of the Nawis Railway Station.
  • This Station uses blue and green as its color scheme. This fashion of design of having one color at each side of this station alludes to San-loop Station and War-Arc Station.[2]
  • As this Station is located directly beneath Oasis Bay Highway, the Station Concourse also acts as a Public Passageway for Passengers to travel to and from each side of the Highway.

History[]

  • April 4 2022: This station completed construction.[3]
  • April 8 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Up Clearings Station to Snipe Valley Station through this station.
  • October 4 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

Everchord Line is Line Number 36 of NR Los Sengas Division. This line has 3 stations, and was established on July 28 2021. It runs between Ramseqeu and Grand Junction.

Description[]

Everchord Line is one of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It passes through Peckern North.

This line is represented by Persian Lime on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 36.

Currently, this route is 4.135 km long, with a total of 3 stations.

History[]

The origins of Everchord Line can be traced back to the later stages of Peckern North Railway planning. A football embassador has suggested the construction of football stadiums in Peckern North, and putting into account traffic flow within Peckern North, two soccer stadiums are constructed on the other side of Tin Kam Pier and Tin Kam Bay.

However, original plans of railway development did not involve railway transport in that area, and they are situated a few kilometers away from the closest point on Glinstrouß Line. Therefore, developers in Peckern North have decided to put the reserved railway extension to use, and reach what is now Grand Junction Station. Subsequent discussion with Nazca Railway has seen the establishment of this line.

Development Chapters[]

  • S3E14P2: Ramseqeu - Grand Junction

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Down Extend Southwest from the Zero Station of an interchange with Glinstrouß Line[1], interchanging with Glinstrouß Line once again[2], before proceeding west.[3] Completed
(Chapter: S3E14P2)

Districts Served[]

  • Peckern North

Line Characteristics[]

  • As this line does not have a planned district served or a planned terminus, this line is seen as an Auxiliary Line instead of a District Line.
  • The Chinese name and the color scheme of this line alludes to the Jōban Line of the East Japan Railway Company with hopes that this line can have a strong foundation of population served and can extend frequently.
  • As this line has plans to interchange with Glinstrouß Line multiple times, there are speculation that this line serves as a circular "Chord" for Glinstrouß Line.

Fun Facts[]

  • Initial stages of planning has seen this line using Gravel as the representative texture of this line. Hence, Peckern North developers have jokingly referred to this line as "Gravel Line" and even confused the pronounciation of it with the existing Veloduct Bravo Line.
  • This line may extend to Havenore Station, which features Arcgo Line and Prospektious Line, and extend to Poon Tong Station, which features Phoenix Line and will also feature Glinstrouß Line as well, in the future.

title: Exalt Gardens
safeHtml:
Exalt Gardens is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central North Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-08.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing
    • 2.1 Public Housing
    • 2.2 Home Ownership Scheme

    • 2.4 Private Housing

    • 3.2 Major Roads
  • 4 Citations and References

History[]

There has been two possible sources regarding the name of Exalt Gardens. One of them has to do with paying homage to Kay Lee, a member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other was the fact that many billionaires spent money in this District to build a garden that appeared fancy but had also given rise to complaints about the gardens wasting public funds. Ultimately, the said garden, which was named "Exalt Gardens" was demolished due to public backlash.

Exalt Garden is one of the few Sub-Districts that did not undergo major changes from the planning stage, with its main development being the construction of Public Housing and a Major Wet Market. However, as the size of the Wet Market has been vastly overestimated, the unused land from its construction has become Housing Land Use in the form of Sheung Chi Estate and Yee Hin Court.

Despite being named "Exalt Gardens", the Police Station and the Library in this District have the prefix of "Brighton Hall".

Description[]

Expo Line is one of the branch lines of NR Los Sengas Division which serves as an auxiliary line, and travels within Peckern.

This line is represented by Red on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 1A.

Currently, this route is 2.225 km long, with a total of 3 stations.

History[]

  • S2E11: LSWorld-Expo - Purple Gate

Districts Served[]

  • Peckern

Line Charcteristics[]

  • This line is the first branch line of West Ring Line.
  • This line is the first line in NR Los Sengas Division to complete construction along all stations involved before connecting its tracks.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line has plans to extend to Tin Kam. However, it was not mentioned in any official documents of NR.

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station is one of the Group 2 Gateways of Nazca Railway, and is located at approximately 20 km to the northwest of Metropolis Terminal.[5]
  • Coincidentally, this station is the 365th station built in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and as a year typically has four seasons and 365 days when Leap Years are not considered, the new Group of Gateways uses different seasons as its theme.

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station is located directly to the north of Havenore Station, as Arcgo Line is projected to go northwest, and with this station using east-west oriented platforms, a Question-Mark bend is made before Arcgo Line trains reach this station.[6] A similar arrangement is also seen for West Ring Line between Comp Ward Station and Pan-ward Station.
  • This Station has set up a template for Group 2 Gateways with the regards that the colored glass is located to the sides of the tracks instead of at the platform gates.[7] Noticeably, another feature of Group 2 Gateways with the exception of Spring Point Gateway is the colored patterns of Concrete behind the Walls next to the stained glass. For Upper Level Platforms, the representative colored concrete is located beneath the Light Gray Concrete, and for Lower Level Platforms, the representative colored concrete is located above the Light Gray Concrete.
  • To allude to the Enclosed curse of Arcgo Line, the concourse of this station is built directly above the Arcgo Line Platforms.[8]
  • This Station is the last station in Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) built before the expansion of West Shoal Checkpoint to have its own wiki page.
  • All Group 2 Gateways make use of a shape at the sides of its walls. This Station uses Hexagons.

History[]

  • August 11 2021: This station began construction.
  • August 13 2021: This station completed construction.
  • August 14 2021: This station began services alongside Arcgo Line, but other platforms in this station remain reserved.
  • December 9 2024: This station began setting up Phoenix Line, Golf Line systems.
  • December 10 2024: This Station completed setting up of Phoenix Line, Golf Line systems.[9]
  • December 11 2024: Phoenix Line and Golf Line extends from Skylark Station and Skyhorse Station respectively to this station.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • The elevators at the lower platforms does not seem right and seems to have one more button than usual. Try pressing it.
  • Beware of the water flushing you down to the Void.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a pile of sugar.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Coop
    • Memory
    • Timing

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station was originally named Congrass Island Station, as the name of the island had been modified due to historical reasons, this station had to be renamed as well.[5]
  • For all Arcgo Line Stations within West Metropolis Archipelago, a body of water behind a pane of glass is used for identification. In this station, the pane of glass is located behind the platform.

History[]

  • May 13 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • December 18 2015: This station ompleted expansion. During the expansion, a set of stacked side platforms are added. At the same day, Arcgo Line extends from Deepond Island Station to this station.
  • April 4 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • March 11 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[7]
  • June 26 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]
  • June 25 2022: Exits A2, D and E are added to this station while all existing exits are named.[9]
  • August 9 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[10]
  • April 25 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.
  • February 29 2024: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • April 12 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.

Fun Facts[]

  • The station number of Origin Line for this station was 13-05. However, it has later been changed to 13-06 with the completion of Samenta Station.
  • The Chinese Name of this station corresponds to Riverwest Station of the Central-Yowah Railway.
  • After the Coopol Line expansion, Exit C has been relocated from the North Side of the Station to the South Concourse.
  • This Station features the first set of 3D Elevators between the South Concourse and the Coopol Line Platforms.

History[]

  • February 24 2020: The Platforms of this station completed construction.[4]
  • February 26 2020: This station began services alongside Origin Line.
  • July 14 2022: Due to the completion of Samenta Station, the Origin Line station number has changed from 13-05 to 13-06.[5]
  • July 10 2025: This station began expansion of the Coopol Line Part.
  • July 13 2025: This station completed expansion of the Coopol Line Part.
  • July 14 2025: Coopol Line extends from Sandgap Station to this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Gray color scheme is used in this station. While most feathers from birds are white, as most feather pans have gray feathers, this color is used instead.[5]
  • This Station is the first and currently the only station in Nazca Railway featuring a "Feather Landing Device". It is set up between the Platform and the Platform Passageway. It was also aptly named the "You Come Down Device".
  • While this station previously had connections to Southern Loop Trailer & Feather Island Station, due to Feather Island regeneration, that station had been demolished.

History[]

  • May 13 2019: This Station began services.

title: Field Joy
safeHtml:
Field Joy is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is the Southernmost Sub-District of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-12.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Future Development
  • 3 Housing
    • 3.1 Public Housing
    • 3.2 Home Ownership Scheme
    • 3.3 Private Sector Participation Scheme
    • 3.4 Private Housing
  • 4 Transport
    • 4.1 Major Roads
  • 5 Citations and References

History[]

The name of this Sub-District originates from a Vocalist who has a psychedelic voice to heal wounded hearts. Her descendants were also inspired by this and made use of Singing Bowl Therapy to bring joy to citizens living in this district. This method of therapy has been reevaluated and saw this method of Therapy as an important part of Sound Therapy. This became the namesake of this Sub-District in order to praise the contributions of the singer to Sound Therapy.

Field Joy is also the Sub-District which has undergoen the most drastic changes due to Asylum replanned development. Original Plans had seen the Southwest of this District constructing a School Village three times the scale of that in Tin Wing, and as a result of this development, the vicinity of this area featured an abundance of L-shpaed turns and T-junctions. However, with the plans of Snowty development becoming clearer, the Developer of Asylum realized the importance of connectivity between the two districts, and had rebulit them into cross junctions, as well as scrapping the School Village Project and replacing it with Public Housing which later became Tsui Lam Estate, Po Lam Estate, King Lam Estate, Cheung Lam Estate and Kwong Lam Estate. After the replanning of Asylum, Field Joy became one of the Sub-Districts with high Public Housing Proportions at 65%, with its total population exceeding 190 thousand.

Snowty and Field Joy did not have any road access. As a result, Drivers had to make a detour to the north before going south, and pass through Pak Hoi Road to leave Asylum. Many Housing Estates were located at least a kilometer to the southwest of Route 3 Exit 17, with Kwong Lam Estate even being two kilometers to the south. This apparently caused transport issues that had plagued residents of the Field Joy area, and ironically made Field Joy one of the unhappiest areas in Asylum. However, this problem has since been mitigated with the development of the compound Snowty-Asylum Development Area.

It should also be noted that, prior to the rezoning of Asylum, Ming Lam Estate and Ivory Plaza, despite being located within Field Joy, were administered by the Fine Woods subdistrict, but after the rezoning, they are now both located in the Fine Woods subdistrict.

Future Development[]

The current developer of Asylum has collaborated with the developer of Snowty regarding Southwest Field Joy development. Housing Zones will expand to the west or southwest within Field Joy and will mainly focus on Public Hosuing. Public Housing will continue to end with the word "Lam" and Home Ownership Scheme Housing will continue to end with the word "Hei".

Fine Woods is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central East Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-14.

History[]

There has been speculation regarding the origins of the name Fine Woods. One of them has to do with Urban Legends that involved sightings of a woman who likes fine silk wandering in nearby woods by natives. Another possible source of this name is the fact that the developer of Asylum wished his friend who has started a Fan Club for a new Female Singer well.

While Fine Woods had also undergone considerations of renaming, plans to rename that district was ultimately scrapped due to fierce opposition. Subsequently, the Asylum Developer also made changes to plans in Fine Woods, such as increasing the proportion of Public Housing, and removing small parts of Administrative Facilities. However, the plan that involved the integration of a Market, a Leisure Center and a Sports Ground did not see any changes. When Home Ownership Scheme Housing is considered, this Sub-District has up to 80% Public Housing, and this District is also the most populated Sub-District in Asylum with a population of 280'000.
